item.title: Trump Is Expected to Reschedule Cannabis on Monday — Here’s What That Means
item.description: The Trump administration is expected to announce a major shift in federal cannabis policy, potentially rescheduling cannabis to Schedule III. Here’s what’s expected to happen, how realistic it is, and what it actually means.

item.title: CatholicVote Warns Trump Against Cannabis Rescheduling With New Petition
item.description: A Catholic advocacy group is urging President Trump to halt federal cannabis rescheduling. Here’s what they argue, why it matters, and the irony many overlook.

item.title: New Lab Study Finds Cannabis Compounds Kill Ovarian Cancer Cells — Without Harming Healthy Cells
item.description: A new lab study finds CBD and THC kill ovarian cancer cells without harming healthy ones. What the research shows — and why cannabis rescheduling matters for science.

item.title: Trump Removes Cannabis From Schedule I in Historic Executive Order

This is a rare and high-profile case involving a U.S. artist and Eastern Europe’s stringent drug regulations. item.title: Study: Adults Using Cannabis Drinks Report Drinking Less Alcohol
item.description: A new study finds that adults who consume cannabis-infused beverages are more likely to reduce alcohol intake, binge drink less, and substitute cannabis for alcohol.

item.title: Study Finds Lifetime Cannabis Use Linked to Better Cognitive Aging
item.description: A large new study of over 500,000 adults finds that lifetime cannabis use is associated with greater brain volume and improved cognitive performance in aging population.
